title: Lucy integration, proposal lifecycle, consent and safe approval
decision: LU-0300–0339 and LX-0355–0363 own Lucy behaviour and design. UF closes end-to-end cross-app interaction and evidence gaps only.

tasks.title: Crosswalk Lucy owners
tasks.acceptance: Identify precise non-duplicated UI integration gaps against LU and LX.

tasks.title: Preserve entered music intent
tasks.acceptance: Song/mood/draft deep links retain exact ID and constraints without auto-send.

tasks.title: Keep lifecycle visible
tasks.acceptance: A proposed mix never looks like a saved draft or playing set.

tasks.title: Prove ready-only semantics
tasks.acceptance: K songs require K−1 valid directed cached seams, revalidated at approval.

tasks.title: Preserve remote provider consent
tasks.acceptance: Remote prompts need explicit informed consent and an available safe alternative.

tasks.title: Protect idempotent approval
tasks.acceptance: Save draft and Save and play are separate confirmed commands with lost-reply reconciliation.

tasks.title: Retain conversation continuity
tasks.acceptance: History, partial prompts and streaming activity recover across rerender and offline.

tasks.title: Keep approval audio deliberate
tasks.acceptance: Save draft never starts playback; confirmed Save and play respects single audio owner.

title: My Mixes, current/draft identity and render-line hierarchy
decision: Existing draft storage, current mix and priority rendering need easily distinguishable identity and consequence.

tasks.title: Differentiate current and saved drafts
tasks.acceptance: Prominent exact current/draft/revision status and action context.

tasks.title: Clarify draft commands
tasks.acceptance: Edit/copy/prioritize/play/delete appear in safe hierarchy and exact scope.

tasks.title: Make queue causality visible
tasks.acceptance: Prioritized drafts and current rendering show actual order, not misleading parallel promise.

tasks.title: Show genuine render progression
tasks.acceptance: Queued, failed, blocked by storage and ready are separate recoverable states.

tasks.title: Restore recent work context
tasks.acceptance: Returning to a draft preserves scope without switching audio.

tasks.title: Protect swap and Undo
tasks.acceptance: Playback of draft communicates current/draft exchange and recovery.

tasks.title: Keep large draft collections usable
tasks.acceptance: Duplicate titles, long names and many drafts scan without losing actions.

tasks.title: Design empty My Mixes path
tasks.acceptance: No saved mixes gives one direct creation action instead of decorative dead end.

title: Editor sequence, Story/Arrange parity and exact seam identity
decision: Song occurrences, directed seam edges and revision-safe editing must remain exact across different visual representations.

tasks.title: Keep mode semantics identical
tasks.acceptance: Story and Arrange show same ordered occurrences and seam state.

tasks.title: Distinguish song from seam focus
tasks.acceptance: Selection labels and visuals identify exact object even when a song repeats.

tasks.title: Provide reorder alternatives
tasks.acceptance: Pointer drag, touch and keyboard movement preserve focus and reversibility.

tasks.title: Expose current/draft scope
tasks.acceptance: Editor heading and buttons identify revision being modified.

tasks.title: Distinguish energy intent from result
tasks.acceptance: Requested arc and achieved measurements have clear source-backed labels.

tasks.title: Keep inspector in reach
tasks.acceptance: Desktop pane and mobile sheet never cover selection or navigation controls.

tasks.title: Show undo and save provenance
tasks.acceptance: Each mutation communicates scope and remaining recovery.

tasks.title: Measure lengthy mix editing
tasks.acceptance: 40+ song sequence remains fast and navigable at realistic widths.

title: Seam Inspector audition, technique truth and accessible editing
decision: Inspector already offers options, quality checks, audition and Studio; make requested, rendered and heard transition layers unmistakable.

tasks.title: Name directed transition exactly
tasks.acceptance: Show previous and incoming occurrence plus current revision in all tabs.

tasks.title: Lead with actual audition
tasks.acceptance: Play/stop and availability correspond to real preview media, not a fake instant result.

tasks.title: Separate plan and rendered states
tasks.acceptance: Requested, queued, rendered and rated are independently labelled.

tasks.title: Explain possible techniques
tasks.acceptance: Show source-backed options and why others cannot be selected.

tasks.title: Guard timing edits
tasks.acceptance: Bars/cues/entry/exit changes preserve revision guards and reflect re-render needs.

tasks.title: Explain quality and rating
tasks.acceptance: Machine checks and user Good/Bad do not claim proof of sound quality.

tasks.title: Preserve Studio handoff
tasks.acceptance: Open shape editor for exact seam with safe focus and playback ownership.

tasks.title: Validate tab and drawer navigation
tasks.acceptance: Arrow/Home/End/Tab and focus return behave correctly.

title: Eight-lane Stem Studio, shape/grid/list consistency and apply safety
decision: Existing eight-lane and 8–64-cell Stem Studio work must remain accurate and legible through a visual finish.

tasks.title: Preserve cross-mode eight-lane semantics
tasks.acceptance: Both songs' vocal, drum, bass, melody lanes stay identical in Shape/Grid/List.

tasks.title: Make time boundaries explicit
tasks.acceptance: Two-bar cells, positions and beat context remain consistent across grid lengths.

tasks.title: Define selected and solo states
tasks.acceptance: Visible plus accessible cell/solo cues do not rely on colour alone.

tasks.title: Keep Shape beginner-friendly
tasks.acceptance: Accessible broad choices lead to detailed list/grid without vocabulary overload.

tasks.title: Protect preview audio ownership
tasks.acceptance: Hear exact pending shape without overlapping or silently resuming main playback.

tasks.title: Separate AI suggestion and user change
tasks.acceptance: Suggested, adjusted and applied shapes cannot be mistaken for one committed state.

tasks.title: Protect unapplied departure
tasks.acceptance: Close, revision loss and failed Use provide clear recovery without silent mutation.

tasks.title: Verify keyboard manipulation
tasks.acceptance: All necessary grid edits have keyboard or list alternative with readable states.

title: Song requests, bridge routes and explicit atomic consent
decision: Existing request and bridge states need a clear lifecycle and informed user choices without relaxing music safety.

tasks.title: Make request stages readable
tasks.acceptance: Searching, waiting, needs approval, preparing and ready have distinct exact meanings.

tasks.title: Preview full bridge consequences
tasks.acceptance: Show each added song and landing position before approval.

tasks.title: Require explicit route approval
tasks.acceptance: Proposed bridges never silently change active mix or request slots.

tasks.title: Guarantee atomic availability
tasks.acceptance: All bridge seams must really be ready before any route can play.

tasks.title: Communicate no-fit choices
tasks.acceptance: Wait, search bridge and add anyway do not imply a musically safe automatic fit.

tasks.title: Protect concurrent identities
tasks.acceptance: Competing requests cannot duplicate song or steal a reserved location.

tasks.title: Keep audition audio safe
tasks.acceptance: Bridge audition respects preview focus and deliberate Pause.

tasks.title: Preserve responsive drawer access
tasks.acceptance: Search, choices and confirmation remain usable with keyboard inset/zoom.

title: Word/harmonic connections, candidate truth and audition-first discovery
decision: Machine-found lyric and harmonic connections are potential matches, not automatically verified high-quality transitions.

tasks.title: Label evidential strength
tasks.acceptance: Candidate, heard and approved states stay distinct.

tasks.title: Explain why songs connect
tasks.acceptance: Word or harmonic relationship displayed with real provenance.

tasks.title: Prioritise true audition
tasks.acceptance: Only available audio is offered for audition; missing render gets honest status.

tasks.title: Make reviews easy to correct
tasks.acceptance: Good/Bad/skip changes exact intended discovery and can be reversed when supported.

tasks.title: Choose explicit target mix
tasks.acceptance: Adding pair to current/draft states scope and exact identity.

tasks.title: Treat no-results meaningfully
tasks.acceptance: Missing analysis or connection candidates offer appropriate action.

tasks.title: Preserve pair scroll and identity
tasks.acceptance: Pagination/search never transfers actions to wrong suggestion.

tasks.title: Use accessible connection imagery
tasks.acceptance: Lines/motifs supplement labels rather than replacing readable status.

title: Workspace hierarchy, diagnostics, sources, storage and local backups
decision: Existing local operations need action-first hierarchy, honest background work and safe data recovery.

tasks.title: Prioritise actionable issues
tasks.acceptance: Overview separates problems requiring action from healthy job counts.

tasks.title: Explain analysis lifecycle
tasks.acceptance: Queued, running, paused and resumed state reflects true server jobs.

tasks.title: Protect source-folder handling
tasks.acceptance: Disappearing or re-linked drives do not imply mass deletion.

tasks.title: Clarify storage budget
tasks.acceptance: Disposable cache, priority stems and durable originals are visibly different.

tasks.title: Make diagnostics interpretable
tasks.acceptance: Plain explanation and deeper detail when asked support different skill levels.

tasks.title: Show backup data scope
tasks.acceptance: Local archive of app data is not misrepresented as containing original music.

tasks.title: Guard staged restore
tasks.acceptance: Preview replacement/skips, restart and rollback before confirming.

tasks.title: Keep interface settings isolated
tasks.acceptance: Theme, density and motion changes affect no stored mix/audio state.

title: Export progression, exact frozen revisions and blind-study integrity
decision: FLAC export and blinded comparisons already exist; output status and study validity must stay truthful.

tasks.title: Expose frozen export identity
tasks.acceptance: Exact draft/current revision and song scope known before export.

tasks.title: Explain missing render prerequisites
tasks.acceptance: Unready directed seams block export with a repair action.

tasks.title: Show real job stages
tasks.acceptance: Queue, render, encode, verify and complete map to actual jobs.

tasks.title: Confirm output decodes
tasks.acceptance: No completed success until exact frozen file exists and decodes.

tasks.title: Protect snapshot from later edits
tasks.acceptance: Ongoing export cannot silently incorporate new mix revision.

tasks.title: Make download and retry clear
tasks.acceptance: Filename, saved outcome and failure path are visible.

tasks.title: Keep study methods blinded
tasks.acceptance: Hidden condition names cannot leak to listener surface or accessible labels.

tasks.title: Treat missing ratings as missing
tasks.acceptance: Unrated grades never become good results or efficacy proof.

title: Responsive geometry, zoom, mobile keyboard and input parity
decision: Full-app polish must be verified across narrow phones, high zoom, short landscape and dynamic overlays, not only ideal desktop.

tasks.title: Validate 200/400% reflow
tasks.acceptance: Content and actionable controls remain accessible without unintended page horizontal scroll.

tasks.title: Protect player and overlay focus
tasks.acceptance: Sticky chrome/keyboard safe areas do not obscure active buttons or composer.

tasks.title: Verify Lucy mobile composer
tasks.acceptance: Keyboard stays clear of Stop, prompt and approval actions.

tasks.title: Offer non-drag controls
tasks.acceptance: Energy arc, reorder and Studio grid remain functional by buttons/keys.

tasks.title: Use wide space intentionally
tasks.acceptance: Readable bounded content and useful side panels replace stretched paragraphs.

tasks.title: Preserve scroll under updates
tasks.acceptance: Streaming, errors and async task updates do not force lost context.

tasks.title: Compare route feature parity
tasks.acceptance: Desktop and mobile represent identical action semantics and music scope.

title: WCAG accessibility, plain-language status and sensory safety
decision: Automated ARIA and motion tests do not constitute independent WCAG 2.2 AA or assistive-technology acceptance.

tasks.title: Audit landmarks and accessible names
tasks.acceptance: All routes contain correct headings, labels and keyboard order.

tasks.title: Validate component keyboard patterns
tasks.acceptance: Menus, dialogs, tabs, comboboxes and grid follow relevant APG patterns.

tasks.title: Test applicable WCAG 2.2 AA
tasks.acceptance: Contrast, focus, reflow, target size exceptions and drag alternatives verified.

tasks.title: Verify non-colour state language
tasks.acceptance: Planned/ready/failed/selected survive forced colours, grayscale and AT.

tasks.title: Unify musical terminology
tasks.acceptance: Ready, analysed, proposed, queued, saved and playing are consistent and explainable.

tasks.title: Enforce motion preference hierarchy
tasks.acceptance: OS reduced-motion overrides expressive user setting and visual effects.

tasks.title: Prevent announcement overload
tasks.acceptance: Long Lucy streams and background jobs do not spam live regions.

tasks.title: Require real AT journey success
tasks.acceptance: Critical first mix, Library, Lucy, editor and Studio tasks have reviewer/device evidence.

title: Independent visual, human, performance, real-audio and release GO/NO-GO
decision: Existing synthetic visual captures are review candidates and muted E2E cannot prove musical quality or user comprehension.

tasks.title: Approve paired visual baselines
tasks.acceptance: Same fixture/route/state/player/revision/size in Light and Dark, human reviewed.

tasks.title: Run responsive and AT acceptance
tasks.acceptance: Mobile, 400%, forced colours, physical keyboard and screen readers cover core routes.

tasks.title: Measure realistic performance
tasks.acceptance: 20k Library, long Lucy, 40+ editor and active spectrum with named devices and budgets.

tasks.title: Publish human success evidence
tasks.acceptance: Uncoached novice/expert tasks with approved threshold and sample-size caveats.

tasks.title: Listen to real transitions
tasks.acceptance: Actual seams, stems, audio focus and output judged separately from synthetic UI tests.

tasks.title: Verify functional preservation
tasks.acceptance: No unsolicited Pause, wrong exact IDs, consent breach, false ready-only or bad frozen FLAC.

tasks.title: Keep per-task status provenance
tasks.acceptance: ADR, checklist, evidence and JSON updated together only on proven SHA/review.

tasks.title: Require documented release verdict
tasks.acceptance: Zero unresolved P0; P1 decisions, rollback, named owner and independent GO sign-off.
